record.question: Which city is known as the 'Big Apple'?
record.explanation: Answer C: New York. ‘The Big Apple’ is the established nickname of New York City; the NYC Mayor’s Office documents the nickname’s history. Reference: https://www.nyc.gov/html/om/html/97/sp082-97.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
